about: Installing through the session (docs/adr/0030-installing-applications.mdx, decisions 9 and 16): a store with the store and updates grants (sample/StoreProbe.tsx) asks through OxyOSSystem; each request, citing the press that asked it, crosses the host, the compositor (which checks the grant and the input) and the session's side (oxyos_compositor::installs, which reads it strictly), and is answered to the store alone. With no install service on this machine every answer says so, as the session tells it, never a fake install.

steps.name: Install, pressed: the session's answer comes back to the store, that the install service is not there
Check for updates, pressed (the updates grant): answered the same way, and no update is invented
